theorem doubling_cancel_mod_47 (n r : ℕ) (h : 2 * n ≡ 2 * r [MOD 47]) : n ≡ r [MOD 47] := by
  apply (ZMod.natCast_eq_natCast_iff n r 47).mp
  
  have hmul :
      (2 : ZMod 47) * (n : ZMod 47) =
        (2 : ZMod 47) * (r : ZMod 47) := by
    simpa only [Nat.cast_mul] using
      (ZMod.natCast_eq_natCast_iff (2 * n) (2 * r) 47).mpr h
  
  have htwo : (2 : ZMod 47) ≠ 0 := by
    intro hz
    have hd : 47 ∣ 2 := (ZMod.natCast_eq_zero_iff 2 47).mp hz
    omega
  
  letI : Fact (Nat.Prime 47) := ⟨by norm_num⟩
  
  have hinv : (2 : ZMod 47)⁻¹ * 2 = 1 := inv_mul_cancel₀ htwo
  
  calc
    (n : ZMod 47) = 1 * n := by simp
    _ = ((2 : ZMod 47)⁻¹ * 2) * n := by rw [hinv]
    _ = (2 : ZMod 47)⁻¹ * (2 * n) := by rw [mul_assoc]
    _ = (2 : ZMod 47)⁻¹ * (2 * r) := by rw [hmul]
    _ = ((2 : ZMod 47)⁻¹ * 2) * r := by rw [mul_assoc]
    _ = (r : ZMod 47) := by rw [hinv, one_mul]
